grammar.title: Was ist Indirekte Rede?
grammar.hinglish: Direct speech mein tum kisi ke bilkul wahi shabd dohraate ho. Indirect speech mein sirf baat ka matlab report karte ho, aur uske liye Konjunktiv I lagta hai. Iska ek khaas kaam hai — yeh dikhata hai ki baat tumhari nahi hai aur tum uski sachai ki guarantee nahi de rahe. Isi wajah se news mein yeh itna aata hai.

grammar.title: Direkte vs Indirekte Rede
grammar.hinglish: Dono versions saath rakh kar dekho to badlav saaf dikh jaata hai. Teen cheezein badalti hain — quotation marks hat jaate hain, pronoun badal jaata hai (ich se er), aur verb Konjunktiv I mein chala jaata hai.

grammar.title: Berichtende Verben (reporting verbs)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh verbs reported speech shuru karte hain: sagen, berichten, erklären, behaupten, erzählen, mitteilen, erwähnen, schreiben, informieren, betonen. Inme ek chhota farak dhyaan mein rakho — behaupten ka matlab hai "dava karna", jisme thoda shak jhalakta hai, jabki berichten aur mitteilen bilkul neutral hain.

grammar.title: Grundlegende Transformation
grammar.hinglish: Chaar step mein kaam ho jaata hai: pehle dekho ki bol kaun raha hai, phir pronoun badlo, phir verb ko Konjunktiv I mein daalo, aur ant mein quotation marks hata do.

grammar.title: Mit oder ohne "dass"?
grammar.hinglish: Reported clause banane ke do tareeke hain, aur dono sahi hain — bas word order alag hota hai. dass ke bina clause main clause jaisa chalta hai, isliye verb doosri position par rehta hai: Er sagt, er sei krank. Aur dass lagao to woh subordinate clause ban jaata hai, isliye verb end mein chala jaata hai: Er sagt, dass er krank sei. Galti tab hoti hai jab dono ko mila diya jaata hai. Newspapers aur formal reports mein dass ke bina wala version zyada aata hai, kyunki woh halka lagta hai — isliye ise hi default rakho.

grammar.title: Warum Zeitungen Indirekte Rede benutzen
grammar.hinglish: Journalist yeh batata hai ki kya kaha gaya, par uski sachai ki zimmedaari nahi leta. Isliye jab tum newspaper mein Konjunktiv I dekho, to samajh lo ki yeh akhbaar ki apni baat nahi hai — woh kisi aur ka bayaan report kar raha hai.

grammar.title: Berufliche Kommunikation
grammar.hinglish: Office ke reports mein bhi yahi hota hai — tum kisi aur ki baat aage pahunchate ho, bina apni raay milaye. Isliye yeh neutral aur professional lagta hai.

grammar.title: Grundlegende Zeitübersicht
grammar.hinglish: Yeh sabse common badlav hain jo tumhe baar-baar chahiye honge. ist se sei, hat se habe, wird se werde, aur kommt se komme. Inhe pehle pakka kar lo.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan paanch tarah se hoti hain — verb ko Indicative mein chhod dena, pronoun badalna bhool jaana, time reference galat kar dena, direct aur indirect ki punctuation mila dena, ya dass lagane ke baad bhi verb ko doosri position par rakhna.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Faisla aasaan hai — bilkul wahi shabd dena hain to direct speech, aur sirf baat aage pahunchani hai to Indirekte Rede. Aur agar neutral rehna hai, matlab sachai ki zimmedaari nahi leni, to Konjunktiv I use karo.

quiz.q: What does Indirekte Rede report?
options: Another person's words, without claiming they are true
Only facts the speaker knows are correct
quiz.explain: Indirect speech reports what was said, remaining neutral about its truth.

quiz.q: Which mood is used in German indirect speech?
quiz.explain: Konjunktiv I is the standard mood for objective reported speech.

quiz.q: Should you use "dass" before a Konjunktiv I clause?
quiz.explain: "Er sagt, er sei krank" — not "Er sagt, dass er sei krank".

quiz.q: What must you check when converting direct to indirect speech?
options: The pronoun matching the reported speaker
quiz.explain: Pronouns must shift to reflect who is being reported, not stay as the original speaker's "ich".

quiz.q: Why do newspapers frequently use Indirekte Rede?
options: To report statements without confirming their truth
Because it is grammatically required in all writing
quiz.explain: Journalists use Konjunktiv I to stay neutral while reporting what sources said.

desc: "Ich habe gestern gearbeitet." → Er sagt, er habe gestern gearbeitet. The original timeline stays — always.

grammar.title: Was ist Zeitverschiebung?
grammar.hinglish: Yahan ek baat samajhna zaroori hai. Tense is baat se tay nahi hota ki report kab likhi jaa rahi hai, balki is baat se ki asli kaam kab hua tha. English mein aksar sab kuch past mein daal diya jaata hai, par German mein original timeline waisi hi rehti hai.

grammar.title: Gegenwart (Present)
grammar.hinglish: Agar asli baat present ki thi, to reported speech mein bhi present hi rehta hai — yeh English se alag hai, jahan aksar past ban jaata hai.

grammar.title: Vergangenheit (Past)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh ek badi aasaani hai — original chahe Perfekt mein ho ya Präteritum mein, reported speech mein dono Konjunktiv I Perfekt ban jaate hain. Matlab past ke liye sirf ek hi form yaad karni hai.

grammar.title: habe oder sei? Die Hilfsverb-Wahl
grammar.hinglish: Konjunktiv I Perfekt habe ya sei ke saath Partizip II se banta hai — aur in dono mein se kaunsa lagega, yeh bilkul waise hi tay hota hai jaise normal Perfekt mein. Movement aur state change wale verbs sei lete hain (er sei gegangen), aur baaki sab habe (er habe gearbeitet). Matlab yahan naya kuch yaad nahi karna — jo Perfekt mein haben leta hai woh yahan habe lega, aur jo sein leta hai woh sei.

grammar.title: Zukunft (Future)
grammar.hinglish: Future bhi waisa hi rehta hai — werden Konjunktiv I mein werde ban jaata hai aur infinitive end mein chala jaata hai: er werde morgen kommen.

grammar.title: Zeitleisten-Diagramm
grammar.hinglish: Har baar sirf yeh dekho ki kaam kab hua — yeh mat dekho ki report kab ho rahi hai. Present ke liye arbeite, past ke liye habe gearbeitet ya sei gegangen, aur future ke liye werde arbeiten.

grammar.title: Zeitungsbeispiele
grammar.hinglish: Newspapers asli bolne wale ki timeline waisi hi rakhte hain. Isliye habe gestern gesprochen mein "gestern" us minister ka kal hai, akhbaar ka nahi.

grammar.title: Berufliche Kommunikation
grammar.hinglish: Office ke reports mein aksar teeno timelines ek saath aati hain — kya ho chuka hai, kya chal raha hai, aur kya hoga. Isliye ek hi email mein seien, laufe aur werde saath dikh sakte hain.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh saari galtiyan ek hi wajah se hoti hain — time word aur verb form aapas mein match nahi karte. Isliye pehle time word dekho (gestern, heute, morgen), phir uske hisaab se form chuno.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Pehle asli statement dhoondo, phir poochho ki kaam kab hua. Present hai to Konjunktiv I Präsens, past hai to Konjunktiv I Perfekt, aur future hai to werde + infinitive. Sabse aasaan tarika yeh hai ki time word dekh kar form chuno.

quiz.q: What happens to a Present-tense original statement in reported speech?
quiz.explain: Present stays Present in German reported speech.

quiz.q: What happens to BOTH Perfekt and Präteritum in reported speech?
quiz.explain: German simplifies past reporting: both Perfekt and Präteritum become Konjunktiv I Perfekt.

quiz.q: What happens to a Future-tense original statement?
options: It stays Konjunktiv I Futur I
quiz.explain: Future stays Future: "werde + Infinitiv".

quiz.q: What is the key question when choosing the reported tense?
options: When did the ORIGINAL action happen?
quiz.explain: You must preserve the speaker's original timeline, not the reporter's.

quiz.q: Does English typically preserve tense the same way as German reported speech?
options: No — English often shifts everything into the past
quiz.explain: German preserves the original timeline; English often backshifts tense regardless of when the action happened.

grammar.title: Was ist Berichtende Sprache?
grammar.hinglish: Reporting language yeh batati hai ki doosre log kya keh rahe hain — writer khud kya sochta hai, woh nahi. Newspaper baat aage pahunchata hai par uski sachai ki zimmedaari nahi leta, aur Konjunktiv I se yahi signal milta hai.

grammar.title: Neutrale Berichterstattung
grammar.hinglish: Objective reporting mein apni raay nahi aati. Kisi ki baat ko seedha fact ki tarah mat likho — use us insaan ke naam se attribute karo aur Konjunktiv I use karo. Farak dekho: Der Minister hat recht tumhari raay hai, par Der Minister erklärt, die Lage sei stabil sirf report hai.

grammar.title: Berichtende Verben (reporting verbs)
grammar.hinglish: Har reporting verb ka apna rang hota hai, isliye inhe soch kar chuno. berichten aur melden neutral news ke liye hain, erklären aur mitteilen official bayaan ke liye, bestätigen tab jab baat confirm ho rahi ho, aur behaupten tab jab dava par shak ho. Isliye behaupten likhne se hi reader ko lagta hai ki baat sabit nahi hui.

grammar.title: Quellenangabe (source attribution)
grammar.hinglish: Professional writing mein hamesha batate hain ki jaankaari kahan se aayi. Isse text par bharosa banta hai — aur Goethe B2 ki writing mein bhi yeh accha impression deta hai.

grammar.title: Kasus bei Quellenangaben
grammar.hinglish: Har source expression apna case leke aata hai, aur yahi sabse zyada galtiyan karwata hai. Inhe waise hi yaad karo jaise verbs ko unke prepositions ke saath yaad karte ho. laut, gemäß aur zufolge Dativ lete hain, aur nach Angaben ke saath ya to Genitiv aata hai (des Ministeriums) ya von + Dativ. Ek baat khaas hai — zufolge apne noun ke baad aata hai: dem Bericht zufolge, na ki "zufolge dem Bericht".

grammar.title: Journalistischer Stil
grammar.hinglish: Journalistic style ki pehchaan yeh hai — baat objective aur neutral rehti hai, sirf facts aate hain, sentences chhote hote hain, source hamesha diya jaata hai, aur reported baaton mein Konjunktiv I lagta hai.

grammar.title: Berufliche Berichterstattung
grammar.hinglish: Office ke reports mein bhi yahi style chalta hai — baat kisi aur ki hoti hai, isliye use attribute karke neutral rakha jaata hai.

grammar.title: Akademische Berichterstattung
grammar.hinglish: Academic writing mein har baat kisi source se judi hoti hai — study, report ya researchers. Isliye wahan bhi yeh structures baar-baar aate hain.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan paanch tarah se hoti hain — verb do baar laga dena, source expression ke baad galat case, article gira dena, apni raay ghusa dena, ya verb ko Indicative mein chhod dena.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Kisi aur ki baat report karni hai? Pehle source batao, phir sahi reporting verb chuno, verb ko Konjunktiv I mein daalo, apni raay bahar rakho, aur tone neutral rakho. Yaad rakho ki source expression apna case bhi leke aata hai.

quiz.q: What does berichtende Sprache communicate?
options: What other people say, not the writer's own opinion
quiz.explain: Reporting language communicates what sources said, staying neutral about the writer's own view.

quiz.q: Which is more appropriate for a news report: "sagen" or "berichten"?
quiz.explain: "berichten" is the standard journalistic reporting verb; "sagen" is too casual.

quiz.q: What does "laut der Polizei" indicate?
quiz.explain: "laut" introduces the source of the information.

quiz.q: Is "Der Minister hat recht" appropriate neutral reporting?
options: No — it presents an opinion as fact
quiz.explain: This states a subjective evaluation as established fact — the reporter should attribute claims instead.

quiz.q: What are the three questions professional reports answer?
options: Who said it? What did they say? How do I report it neutrally?
What do I believe? What is true? What is false?
quiz.explain: These three questions structure objective, source-attributed reporting.

grammar.title: Funktionsverbgefüge Recap
grammar.hinglish: Noun + fixed light verb simple verb ki jagah leta hai aur register formal bana deta hai: entscheiden se eine Entscheidung treffen. Har noun ka apna light verb hota hai — Entscheidung ke saath treffen, Antrag ke saath stellen, Diskussion ke saath führen. Har jagah machen lagana sabse aam galti hai.

grammar.title: Modalpartikeln Recap
grammar.hinglish: doch yaad dilata hai ya kisi baat ko kaatta hai, ja batata hai ki baat dono ko pehle se pata hai, aur eben/halt dikhate hain ki baat maan li gayi hai — eben neutral aur halt zyada casual. Chaaron Mittelfeld mein baithte hain, na shuru mein aur na end mein. Aur formal writing mein inme se koi nahi aata.

grammar.title: Textkohärenz Recap
grammar.hinglish: Verweiswörter repetition se bachate hain, par reference saaf hona chahiye — agar do cheezon mein confusion ho sakti hai to naam dohraana behtar hai. Gender aur number us noun se aate hain jiski baat ho rahi hai, par case naye sentence se. Aur Absatzlogik ka rule ek hi hai: ek paragraph mein ek idea, aur order rehta hai Leitsatz → Erklärung → Beispiel → Schluss.

grammar.title: Konjunktiv I Recap
grammar.hinglish: Teen forms pehle pakki karo: sei, habe, werde. Timeline waisi hi rehti hai — present present, past ke liye Konjunktiv I Perfekt (habe gearbeitet ya sei gegangen), aur future ke liye werde + infinitive. Dhyaan rakho ki ich, wir aur sie ki forms Indicative jaisi ho jaati hain, isliye wahan Konjunktiv II lagta hai. Aur reporting mein source dena zaroori hai — laut aur zufolge Dativ lete hain.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps
grammar.hinglish: Asli exam mein yeh saare structures ek hi text mein mile-jule aate hain. Har sentence par ek sawaal poochho — yeh formal expression hai, bolchaal ka attitude marker hai, cohesion ka shabd hai, ya reported speech? Yahan speed matter karti hai, rule ratna nahi.

quiz.q: "eine Entscheidung treffen" is which structure?
quiz.explain: Noun + fixed light verb replaces the simple verb "entscheiden" for formal register.

quiz.q: "Setz dich doch." uses "doch" for:
quiz.explain: "doch" here turns a bare command into a friendly, softened request.

quiz.q: "Das ist ja normal." uses "ja" for:
quiz.explain: "ja" points to information both speakers already know or find obvious.

quiz.q: "So ist das eben." expresses:
quiz.explain: "eben" signals calm acceptance of an unchangeable reality.

quiz.q: Which reference word could be ambiguous: "Anna spricht mit Maria. Sie ist freundlich."?
quiz.explain: "Sie" could refer to either woman — repeating the name would remove the ambiguity.

quiz.q: How many main ideas should a well-structured paragraph have?
quiz.explain: One paragraph = one idea, per Absatzlogik.

quiz.q: What is the Konjunktiv I form of "sein" for "er"?
quiz.explain: "sein" has an irregular Konjunktiv I stem: "sei-".

quiz.q: "Er sagt, er habe gestern gearbeitet" shows which time reference rule?
quiz.explain: A past event is reported with Konjunktiv I Perfekt regardless of whether the original was Perfekt or Präteritum.

quiz.q: "Laut der Polizei" is an example of:
quiz.explain: "laut" introduces the source of the reported information.

quiz.q: Is "Der Minister hat recht" appropriate neutral, journalistic reporting?
options: No — it states an opinion as fact
quiz.explain: Neutral reporting attributes claims to their source instead of stating them as fact.

title: Präpositionen mit Genitiv

grammar.title: Was sind Genitiv-Präpositionen?
grammar.hinglish: Kuch prepositions apne baad hamesha Genitiv lete hain. Yeh zyada-tar formal German mein aate hain — newspapers, contracts aur reports mein — isliye reading mein inhe pehchaanna zaroori hai.

grammar.title: Die wichtigsten Genitiv-Präpositionen
grammar.hinglish: Yeh unnees prepositions formal German mein sabse zyada aate hain. Poori list ratne ki zaroorat nahi — pehle chaar (trotz, während, wegen, aufgrund) sabse zyada kaam aate hain, baaki ko pehchaan lena hi kaafi hai.

grammar.title: Register: Formal vs Alltagssprache
grammar.hinglish: Yahan register ka farak samajhna zaroori hai. Bolchaal mein log aksar Dativ laga dete hain — wegen dem Problem — aur woh galat nahi hai, bas casual hai. Par exam ki writing mein Genitiv hi chahiye: aufgrund des Problems.

grammar.title: Genitiv-Artikel
grammar.hinglish: Genitiv mein article badal jaata hai — masculine aur neuter dono des lete hain, aur feminine aur plural dono der. Matlab chaar mein se sirf do forms yaad karni hain.

grammar.title: Das Nomen bekommt auch eine Endung
grammar.hinglish: Sirf article badalna kaafi nahi hai. Genitiv mein masculine aur neuter nouns par bhi ek -s ya -es lagta hai — aur yahi sabse zyada bhoola jaata hai. Feminine aur plural mein noun waisa hi rehta hai, sirf article der ho jaata hai. -es tab lagta hai jab noun ek syllable ka ho ya -s, -ß, -z, -tz par khatam ho (des Kindes, des Gesetzes), warna seedha -s (des Vertrags).

grammar.title: Bedeutungsgruppen (meaning groups)
grammar.hinglish: Inhe random list ki tarah yaad karne ki jagah meaning ke hisaab se group karo — cause wale alag, time wale alag, jagah wale alag. Isse yaad rakhna kaafi aasaan ho jaata hai.

grammar.title: Typische Goethe-Kontexte
grammar.hinglish: Yeh prepositions newspapers, scientific texts, contracts aur official announcements mein bahut aate hain. Bolne mein inme se kuch hi natural lagte hain, isliye inhe zyada-tar padhne aur likhne ke liye seekho.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan do wajah se hoti hain — noun par -s lagana bhool jaana, ya article ko Dativ ya Nominativ mein chhod dena. Dhyaan rakho ki Genitiv mein dono badalte hain, sirf article nahi.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Formal preposition chahiye? Pehle meaning ke hisaab se preposition chuno (cause, time, place, topic, means), phir uske baad Genitiv lagao — aur noun par -s lagana mat bhoolo.

quiz.q: Which case do Genitiv prepositions always require?
quiz.explain: By definition, Genitiv prepositions always take the Genitive case.

quiz.q: Which meaning group does "wegen" belong to?
quiz.explain: "wegen" expresses cause, along with "aufgrund" and "infolge".

quiz.q: Which meaning group does "während" belong to?
quiz.explain: "während" expresses simultaneous time, along with "anlässlich".

quiz.q: Is "wegen dem Regen" appropriate for formal Goethe B2 writing?
options: No — formal writing expects "wegen des Regens"
quiz.explain: "wegen dem Regen" is common in spoken German, but formal writing expects the Genitiv form.

quiz.q: Which preposition expresses benefit/favour?
quiz.explain: "zugunsten" means "in favour of", requiring Genitiv.

title: Wissenschaftssprache
desc: Never write "I think...". Instead write "Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass...". Objective. Precise. Evidence-based.

grammar.title: Was ist Wissenschaftssprache?
grammar.hinglish: Academic language universities, research, reports aur theses mein use hoti hai. Iska maksad simple hai — jaankaari saaf, objective aur precise tarike se rakhna, bina apni raay milaye.

grammar.title: Merkmale des Akademischen Deutsch
grammar.hinglish: Academic German objective, precise aur neutral hoti hai, aur har baat evidence par tiki hoti hai. Isme emotional shabd, exaggeration, slang aur apni raay nahi aati — isliye toll, super aur cool jaise shabd yahan kaam nahi karte.

grammar.title: Typische akademische Ausdrücke
grammar.hinglish: Yeh fixed expressions academic German ki reedh hain. Inhe poore chunk ki tarah yaad kar lo — phir writing mein seedha use kar sakte ho, aur har baar naya sentence banane ki zaroorat nahi padegi.

grammar.title: Objektiv vs Alltagssprache
grammar.hinglish: Ek hi baat ko dono tarike se dekho — matlab wahi rehta hai, bas register badal jaata hai. Dhyaan do ki academic version mein subject bhi badal jaata hai: die Idee ki jagah die Ergebnisse aa jaate hain.

grammar.title: Das Subjekt wechselt: nicht "ich", sondern die Sache
grammar.hinglish: Upar ke har academic example mein ek hi cheez ho rahi hai — subject koi insaan nahi hai. ich ki jagah sentence die Studie, die Daten, die Ergebnisse ya die Analyse se shuru hota hai, aur verb yeh batata hai ki woh kya dikha rahe hain. Bas yahi ek badlav zyada-tar kaam kar deta hai, kyunki isse writer sentence se hat jaata hai — aur iske liye koi mushkil vocabulary nahi chahiye. Passive aur sich lassen (Chapter 44–46) bhi yahi kaam karte hain.

grammar.title: Ergebnisse beschreiben
grammar.hinglish: Results describe karne ke liye useful structures: die Ergebnisse zeigen..., die Analyse verdeutlicht..., die Daten lassen erkennen..., es konnte festgestellt werden..., die Untersuchung bestätigt...

grammar.title: Daten und Trends beschreiben
grammar.hinglish: Data ke badlav batane ke liye Nominalstil (Chapter 50) kaam aata hai — Die Zahl stieg ki jagah Es lässt sich ein Anstieg feststellen. Isse baat zyada formal aur measured lagti hai.

grammar.title: Register
grammar.hinglish: Academic language university lectures, seminar papers, scientific journals, reports, research presentations, bachelor's theses, aur company analyses mein aati hai.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Paanchon galtiyan ek hi jad se aati hain — ya to writer khud sentence mein aa jaata hai, ya shabd report karne ki jagah judgement dene lagte hain. Har correction mein dekho: subject insaan se hatkar cheez par chala jaata hai.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Academic text likh rahe ho? Apni raay bahar rakho, objective expressions use karo, har baat ko evidence se jodo, aur register formal rakho. Sabse tez trick yeh hai — Ich denke ki jagah Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass … likho.

quiz.q: What are the key characteristics of Wissenschaftssprache?
quiz.explain: Academic German is objective, precise, neutral, evidence-based, logical, and formal.

quiz.q: Which expression is used for presenting findings?
quiz.explain: "Die Untersuchung zeigt, dass..." is a fixed academic expression for objectively presenting findings.

quiz.q: Which expression is used for drawing conclusions?
quiz.explain: "Daraus ergibt sich..." draws a logical conclusion from evidence.

quiz.q: Is "Ich finde, die Studie ist toll" appropriate for academic writing?
options: No — it is subjective and informal
quiz.explain: This phrasing is subjective and colloquial — academic writing requires objective, evidence-based expressions.

quiz.q: What should replace "Ich denke/glaube" in academic writing?
options: Objective expressions like "Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass..."
Nothing — it is fine as is
quiz.explain: Academic German never presents personal opinion as the basis for a claim — it relies on evidence.

options: Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass die Methode zuverlässig funktioniert.
Man kann sagen, es funktioniert vielleicht.

title: Argumentieren: Standpunkte
desc: Opinion + Reason + Example + Conclusion = a strong B2 argument. Agree, disagree politely, stay logical.

story.headline: Opinion. Reason. Example. Conclusion.
story.intro: Preparing for a Goethe B2 speaking exam on artificial intelligence in education, Katrin argues that remote work saves time, and Timo pushes back — opinion, reason, agreement, and polite disagreement, in careful order.

lines.de: Ich vertrete den Standpunkt, dass Homeoffice gut ist.

lines.de: Stimmst du auch zu, dass die Nachteile überwiegen?

lines.de: Gut, dann diskutieren wir weiter.

lines.hi: Achha, toh hum aage charcha karte hain.

grammar.title: Was ist ein Standpunkt?
grammar.hinglish: Standpunkt matlab tumhari raay — par akeli raay kaafi nahi hoti. Uske saath reason, ek example aur ek conclusion hona chahiye. Goethe B2 ki writing aur speaking mein yahi chaar cheezein check hoti hain.

grammar.title: Meinungen ausdrücken
grammar.hinglish: Raay batane ke kai tarike hain, aur register alag-alag hai. Ich denke aur Meiner Meinung nach rozmarra mein chalte hain, aur Meines Erachtens ya Ich vertrete die Ansicht formal writing mein. Exam mein ek hi expression baar-baar mat dohrao — badal-badal kar use karo.

grammar.title: Wortstellung bei Meinungsäußerungen
grammar.hinglish: In expressions ke do group hain aur dono ka word order alag hai. Kuch dass-clause kholte hain, isliye unme verb sentence ke end mein jaata hai: Ich bin der Meinung, dass Homeoffice sinnvoll ist. Aur kuch khud position 1 le lete hain, isliye unke turant baad verb aata hai, subject se pehle: Meiner Meinung nach sollte man das ändern. Do fixed forms dhyaan se yaad rakho — der Meinung sein mein article hamesha rehta hai, aur meiner Meinung nach mein nach noun ke baad aata hai.

grammar.title: Gründe angeben
grammar.hinglish: Reason dene ke liye yeh shabd kaam aate hain: weil, da, denn, nämlich, aus diesem Grund, deshalb, daher. Dhyaan rakho ki weil aur da verb ko clause ke end mein bhejte hain, jabki denn, deshalb aur daher ke saath normal order rehta hai. Raay hamesha reason ke saath do — bina reason ke argument adhoora hai.

grammar.title: Argumente unterstützen
grammar.hinglish: Poora model yeh hai: pehle apni raay, phir uska reason, phir ek example, aur ant mein nateeja. Yeh chaar step har writing task mein kaam aate hain.

grammar.title: Zustimmen (agreeing)
grammar.hinglish: Sehmat hone ke liye yeh expressions hain: Ich stimme dir zu, Da hast du recht, Das sehe ich genauso, Ich teile diese Ansicht. Dhyaan do ki zustimmen Dativ leta hai (dir, Ihnen) aur uska zu end mein jaata hai.

grammar.title: Höflich widersprechen (disagreeing politely)
grammar.hinglish: Asehmati politely batane ke liye: Ich sehe das anders, Ich bin anderer Meinung, Dem kann ich nicht ganz zustimmen. German mein seedha “Nein, das ist falsch” kehna rukha lagta hai — isliye nicht ganz jaise shabd jod dene se baat narm ho jaati hai.

grammar.title: Ausgewogene Argumentation
grammar.hinglish: Balanced argument ka structure yeh hai: apni raay, phir doosri taraf ki baat, phir uspar jawaab, aur ant mein nateeja. Doosre point of view ko maan lena kamzori nahi hai — isse argument aur mazboot lagta hai, aur exam mein iske marks bhi milte hain.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan chaar wajah se hoti hain — apni baat kahe bina seedha reason par kood jaana, fixed expression ka article gira dena, reason mein wahi baat dohra dena, ya clause adhoora chhod dena.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Raay deni hai? Pehle apna standpoint batao, phir reason do, phir ek example, phir doosri taraf ki baat par bhi nazar daalo, aur ek saaf nateeje ke saath khatam karo. Yeh chaar sawaal yaad rakho — main kya sochta hoon, kyun, iska proof kya hai, aur nateeja kya nikla.

story.headline: Address the other side. Fairly.
story.intro: Still preparing for the same Goethe B2 exam, Timo raises a counterargument about loneliness in remote work, and Katrin concedes the point before countering with regular meetings — a stronger argument built by addressing the other side fairly.

grammar.title: Was ist ein Gegenargument?
grammar.hinglish: Achhi discussion ka order yeh hota hai: apni raay, phir doosri taraf ki baat, phir uspar jawaab, aur ant mein nateeja. Doosre ki baat ko ignore kar dena kamzor argument banata hai — exam mein bhi iske marks kat jaate hain.

grammar.title: Gegenargumente einführen (introducing counterarguments)
grammar.hinglish: Doosri taraf ki baat rakhne ke liye yeh expressions kaam aate hain. Andererseits aur Auf der anderen Seite normal discussion mein chalte hain, aur Kritiker argumentieren, dass … ya Es gibt jedoch auch die Ansicht, dass … formal writing mein. Dhyaan do ki inme se kai position 1 lete hain, isliye verb turant baad aayega.

grammar.title: Wortstellung: gefronteter Konnektor und zwar … aber
grammar.hinglish: Is chapter ki zyada-tar galtiyan do word-order points se aati hain. Pehla — Andererseits, Allerdings, Dennoch aur Trotzdem position 1 le lete hain, isliye inke turant baad verb aata hai, subject se pehle: Andererseits ist das teuer. Doosra — zwar … aber ek fixed jodi hai, aur zwar ke baad bhi verb turant aa jaata hai. zwar ko clause ke beech mein bhi rakh sakte ho: Das Angebot ist zwar teuer, aber es lohnt sich. Aur jedoch thoda flexible hai — woh shuru mein bhi aa sakta hai aur beech mein bhi.

grammar.title: Andere Meinungen anerkennen (acknowledging)
grammar.hinglish: Doosre ki baat ko maan-ne ke liye yeh phrases hain: Das stimmt teilweise, Ich kann diesen Standpunkt nachvollziehen, Das ist ein berechtigter Einwand. Yeh kehne se tum apni baat nahi haarte — balki argument zyada mazboot aur mature lagta hai.

grammar.title: Auf Gegenargumente reagieren
grammar.hinglish: Jawaab dene ka order yeh hai: pehle doosri taraf ki baat maano, phir apna jawaab do, uska reason do, ek example do, aur nateeje par pahuncho.

grammar.title: Vor- und Nachteile abwägen
grammar.hinglish: Dono taraf ko taulne ke liye yeh structures hain: Einerseits …, andererseits …, Zwar …, aber …, Auf der einen Seite …, auf der anderen Seite …. Aur ant mein Trotzdem überwiegen die Vorteile jaisa vaakya batata hai ki tumhare hisaab se kaunsa pehlu bhaari hai.

grammar.title: Höfliche Widerlegung (polite refutation)
grammar.hinglish: Politely khandan karne ke liye: Dennoch bin ich überzeugt, dass …, Allerdings spricht mehr für …, Dieses Argument überzeugt mich nicht vollständig. Dhyaan do ki nicht vollständig jaise shabd baat ko narm rakhte hain — seedha “falsch” kehne se baat rukhi lagti hai.

grammar.title: Ausgewogene Diskussionen aufbauen
grammar.hinglish: Poora structure yeh hai: apni raay, doosri taraf ki baat, uska imaandaar mulyankan, phir apni final raay, aur nateeja. Doosre point of view ko kabhi ignore mat karo — uspar jawaab dena hi asli argument hai.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan paanch tarah se hoti hain — reason mein wahi baat dohra dena, fronted connector ke baad verb ko doosri jagah par na rakhna, zwar ke saath galat jodi lagana, separable prefix galat jagah rakhna, ya do contrast words ek saath laga dena.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Kisi topic par discussion karni hai? Apni raay batao, doosri taraf ki baat rakho, use imaandaari se tolo, politely jawaab do, aur apne nateeje par khatam karo. Yaad rakho — achhi B2 discussion balanced aur logical hoti hai, emotional nahi.

quiz.q: What is the five-step structure of a balanced discussion?
options: My opinion → my reason → another viewpoint → my response → final conclusion
quiz.explain: This is the full discussion model taught in this chapter, building on the four-step argument model from Chapter 66.

quiz.q: Which expression introduces a counterargument academically?
quiz.explain: "Kritiker argumentieren, dass..." attributes an opposing view to critics, common in formal discussion.

quiz.q: Which expression acknowledges partial truth in a counterargument?
quiz.explain: "Daran ist etwas Wahres" concedes that the counterargument has some validity.

quiz.q: Is "Zwar ..., sondern ..." a correct pairing?
quiz.explain: "zwar" is always paired with "aber" for balanced comparison.

quiz.q: Should a strong B2 discussion ignore opposing views?
options: No — it should address them fairly before concluding
Yes, focus only on your own opinion
quiz.explain: Strong arguments become stronger when they address opposing opinions fairly, not by ignoring them.

title: Redemittel für Diskussionen
desc: Grammar helps you build sentences. Redemittel help you sound natural. Open. Ask. Listen. Respond. Clarify. Summarize. Conclude.

story.headline: Grammar builds sentences. Redemittel sound natural.

grammar.title: Was sind Redemittel?
grammar.hinglish: Redemittel woh fixed phrases hain jo bina soche muh se nikal jaate hain. Grammar aana aur fluently bolna do alag cheezein hain — Redemittel yahi gap bharte hain. Inhe poore chunk ki tarah yaad karo, shabd-dar-shabd banane ki koshish mat karo.

grammar.title: Diskussionsablauf (Discussion Flow)
grammar.hinglish: Poori discussion nau stages mein chalti hai, aur har stage ka apna phrase hota hai. Exam se pehle yeh table dekh lo — har stage se ek-ek phrase yaad kar lo, itna kaafi hai.

grammar.title: Diskussion beginnen
grammar.hinglish: Discussion shuru karne ke liye yeh phrases kaam aate hain: Lassen Sie uns beginnen, Heute geht es um …, Ich würde gern mit … anfangen. Do-teen yaad kar lo, phir har baar ek hi se shuru nahi karna padega.

grammar.title: Nach Meinungen fragen
grammar.hinglish: Saamne wale ki raay poochhne ke liye: Was halten Sie davon?, Wie sehen Sie das?, Was denken Sie darüber?. Exam mein yeh bahut kaam aata hai — partner se sawaal poochhna dikhata hai ki tum discussion chala sakte ho.

grammar.title: Zustimmen (agreeing)
grammar.hinglish: Sehmat hone ke liye: Ich stimme Ihnen zu, Da haben Sie recht, Das sehe ich genauso. Genau aur Das stimmt chhote aur casual hain, jabki Ich teile diese Ansicht formal lagta hai.

grammar.title: Höflich widersprechen
grammar.hinglish: Asehmati ke liye: Ich sehe das etwas anders, Dem kann ich nicht ganz zustimmen, Das überzeugt mich nicht vollständig. Dhyaan do ki etwas, nicht ganz aur nicht vollständig hi woh shabd hain jo baat ko polite banate hain.

grammar.title: Klären und nachfragen
grammar.hinglish: Kuch samajh na aaye to poochhna kamzori nahi hai — exam mein iske marks milte hain. Könnten Sie das näher erklären?, Was meinen Sie genau?, Habe ich Sie richtig verstanden? — yeh dikhate hain ki tum dhyaan se sun rahe ho.

grammar.title: Höflich unterbrechen
grammar.hinglish: Beech mein bolna ho to sawaal ki tarah bolo: Darf ich kurz etwas sagen?, Entschuldigung, darf ich ergänzen? German mein seedha tok dena rukha lagta hai — permission maangne se hi baat polite ban jaati hai.

grammar.title: Zusammenfassen und abschließen
grammar.hinglish: Ant mein summary dena zaroori hai: Zusammenfassend kann man sagen, dass …, Insgesamt …, Daraus lässt sich schließen, dass …. Aur khatam karne ke liye Vielen Dank für die Diskussion kaafi hai. Exam mein summary dena bhool mat jaana — isse discussion poori lagti hai.

grammar.title: Formell vs informell
grammar.hinglish: Ek hi kaam ke do roop dekho — informal aur formal. Exam mein aksar formal chahiye hota hai, isliye Genau! ki jagah Dem kann ich zustimmen behtar lagta hai.

grammar.title: Sie oder du — und was sich dabei ändert
grammar.hinglish: Is chapter ke lagbhag saare Redemittel do roop mein aate hain — du wala aur Sie wala. Speaking test mein sabse jaldi galat yahi lagta hai ki beech mein register badal jaaye. Isliye discussion ke shuru mein ek register chuno aur usi par tike raho. Badlav mechanical hai: pronoun, uska Dativ form aur verb ki ending — teeno saath badalte hain. du se dir aur Sie se Ihnen, aur dono capital letter se likhe jaate hain. Goethe B2 ke speaking mein aksar Sie hi use hota hai.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan aksar English ya Hindi se seedha translate karne se hoti hain. German ke apne fixed phrases hain — unhe waise hi yaad karo, shabd-dar-shabd banane ki koshish mat karo.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Discussion mein bolna hai? Politely shuru karo, saamne wale ki raay poochho, apni baat rakho, izzat se jawaab do, kuch samajh na aaye to poochho, ant mein summary do, aur naturally khatam karo. Grammar sentence banana sikhata hai — Redemittel natural lagna sikhate hain.

quiz.q: What are Redemittel?
options: Fixed expressions used to communicate naturally
quiz.explain: Redemittel bridge the gap between knowing grammar and speaking fluently.

quiz.q: Which expression opens a discussion?
quiz.explain: "Lassen Sie uns beginnen" is a standard formal discussion opener.

quiz.q: Which expression politely asks for clarification?
quiz.explain: "Könnten Sie das näher erklären?" politely requests more detail.

quiz.q: Is "Ich unterbreche" a polite way to interrupt?
options: No — too direct; use "Darf ich kurz etwas sagen?"
quiz.explain: Announcing an interruption directly is impolite — use a polite question instead.

quiz.q: What is the full discussion rhythm taught in this chapter?
options: Open → Ask → Listen → Respond → Clarify → Summarize → Conclude
quiz.explain: This seven-part rhythm structures every successful Goethe B2 discussion.

quiz.q: Complete: "Die Entscheidung ___ gestern getroffen." (Passiv Präteritum)
quiz.explain: Passiv Präteritum: wurde + Partizip II.

quiz.q: Complete: "Er behauptet, er ___ die Prüfung bereits bestanden." (Konjunktiv I, Perfekt)
quiz.explain: Konjunktiv I Perfekt: habe + Partizip II, for reported speech.

quiz.q: Which relative pronoun fits: "die Frau, ___ Sohn Arzt ist"?
quiz.explain: "deren" replaces a feminine possessive (ihr) inside a relative clause.

quiz.q: Which Genitiv preposition means "in view of"?
quiz.explain: "angesichts" = in view of/given, and takes the Genitiv.

quiz.q: What does "sich lassen + Infinitiv" express?
quiz.explain: "Das Problem lässt sich lösen" = the problem can be solved (Passiversatz).

quiz.q: Which sentence uses Nominalstil correctly?
options: Die Überprüfung der Ergebnisse erfolgte gestern.
Die Ergebnisse wurden gestern überprüft, weil.
quiz.explain: Nominalisierung turns the verb "überprüfen" into the noun "Überprüfung" for formal/academic style.

quiz.q: Which is a correct Funktionsverbgefüge for "to decide"?
quiz.explain: "eine Entscheidung treffen" is the fixed Funktionsverbgefüge; "machen"/"tun" are incorrect collocations.

quiz.q: What does the Modalpartikel "doch" typically add to a statement?
options: A softening or reminding tone, not new facts
quiz.explain: Modalpartikeln like "doch" shift attitude/tone without changing the factual content.

quiz.q: Which expression introduces a counterargument academically?
quiz.explain: "Kritiker argumentieren, dass..." attributes an opposing view to critics, common in formal discussion.

quiz.q: Which is the polite way to interrupt a discussion?
quiz.explain: "Darf ich kurz etwas sagen?" is the standard polite way to interrupt.

quiz.q: Complete: "___ der schlechten Wetterbedingungen fand das Fest statt." (Genitivpräposition)
quiz.explain: "Trotz" + Genitiv = despite; fits the concessive meaning here.

quiz.q: Which sentence uses the Partizipialattribut correctly?
quiz.explain: Partizip II as an attributive adjective: "der [gestern veröffentlichte] Bericht" — modifier before the noun, correctly declined.

quiz.q: Complete: "Sie haben die Aufgabe ___, ohne Fehler zu machen." (Infinitiv mit zu)
quiz.explain: "ohne...zu + Infinitiv" is the fixed construction for "without doing something".

quiz.q: Which connector expresses an unexpected contrast (adverb, verb-second)?
quiz.explain: "trotzdem" is an adverb triggering verb-second word order; "obwohl"/"weil" are subordinating conjunctions (verb-final).

quiz.q: What is the full discussion rhythm from Chapter 68?
options: Open → Ask → Listen → Respond → Clarify → Summarize → Conclude
quiz.explain: This seven-part rhythm structures every successful Goethe B2 discussion.

quiz.q: Which is an example of Wissenschaftssprache (impersonal/objective style)?
quiz.explain: "Es lässt sich feststellen, dass..." removes the personal subject for objective academic style.

quiz.q: Complete the four-step B2 argument structure: Opinion → Reason → ___ → Conclusion.
quiz.explain: Opinion + Reason + Example + Conclusion is the core B2 argument model from Chapter 66.

quiz.q: Which sentence correctly forms the bekommen-Passiv?
quiz.explain: bekommen-Passiv: bekommen + Partizip II, with the recipient as subject.

quiz.q: What replaces the subject in the "unpersönliches Passiv"?
options: Nothing — "es" is a placeholder or is dropped
quiz.explain: Unpersönliches Passiv has no real grammatical subject; "es" is only a placeholder in first position.

quiz.q: Which sentence uses indirekte Rede (reported speech) correctly at B2?
options: Sie sagte, sie war krank gewesen.
quiz.explain: Reported speech uses Konjunktiv I ("sei") to mark the statement as someone else's claim.

title: Tempusgebrauch & Stilistische Tempuswahl
desc: B2 asks: which tense is correct? C1 asks: which tense sounds best. Master why native writers deliberately switch tenses for effect.

story.headline: Correct German. Natural German. Elegant German.
story.intro: Preparing a university research presentation, Meret uses the historical present for her opening scene to create tension, and Timo wonders if the tense-shifting mid-article will confuse readers — discovering why native writers deliberately switch tenses for effect.

lines.de: Ich habe das historische Präsens für die Eröffnungsszene genutzt.
lines.en: I have used the historical present for the opening scene.
lines.hi: Maine shuruaati drishya ke liye aitihasik vartamaan kaal ka istemaal kiya hai.

lines.de: Das ist eine kluge Tempuswahl, da es Spannung erzeugt.
lines.en: That is a clever tense choice, since it creates tension.
lines.hi: Yeh ek samajhdaar kaal chayan hai, kyunki yeh tanaav paida karta hai.

lines.de: Danach wechsle ich zur Zeitschichtung im mittleren Absatz.
lines.en: After that I switch to the layering of time in the middle paragraph.
lines.hi: Uske baad main beech ke anuchhed mein samay ki parat ki or badalti hoon.

lines.de: Ist das nicht verwirrend für die Leser?
lines.en: Is that not confusing for the readers?
lines.hi: Kya yeh paathakon ke liye ulajhan bhara nahi hai?

lines.de: Meine Vermutung ist, dass die Leser den Wechsel klar erkennen.
lines.en: My assumption is that the readers will clearly recognize the change.
lines.hi: Mera anumaan hai ki paathak badlaav ko saaf pehchaan lenge.

lines.de: Meine Schlussfolgerung ist, dass der Artikel insgesamt gelungen ist.
lines.en: My conclusion is that the article is overall successful.
lines.hi: Mera nishkarsh hai ki lekh kul milakar safal hai.

lines.de: Danke! Deine Rückmeldung hilft mir sehr.
lines.en: Thanks! Your feedback helps me very much.
lines.hi: Dhanyavaad! Tumhaari pratikriya mujhe bahut madad karti hai.

grammar.title: Warum die Tempuswahl zählt
grammar.hinglish: C1 par sawaal badal jaata hai. B2 tak tum poochhte the “kaunsa tense sahi hai?”, aur ab poochhna hai “kaunsa tense yahan sabse achha lagta hai?” Kai tenses grammar ke hisaab se sahi ho sakte hain, par har context mein ek hi natural lagta hai.

grammar.title: Präsens jenseits der Gegenwart
grammar.hinglish: Präsens sirf “abhi” ke liye nahi hota. Yeh scientific writing mein aata hai, instructions mein, universal sach batane mein, newspaper headlines mein, aur historic present mein — jahan purani ghatna ko jaan-boojhkar present mein sunaya jaata hai taaki woh jeevit lage.

grammar.title: Präteritum vs Perfekt (stilistisch)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh farak style ka hai, time ka nahi. Präteritum likhi hui German mein chalta hai — novels, news aur academic texts. Aur Perfekt bolne mein — baatcheet, interviews aur kahaani sunaate waqt. Dono ka matlab past hi hai.

grammar.title: Plusquamperfekt: narrative Schichtung
grammar.hinglish: Plusquamperfekt ek layer peeche jaane ke liye hota hai. Jab kahani Präteritum mein chal rahi ho aur tumhe batana ho ki usse pehle kya hua tha, tab yeh lagta hai. Isliye ise background wala tense samjho.

grammar.title: Futur I: stilistischer Gebrauch
grammar.hinglish: Futur I sirf future ke liye nahi hai. Yeh andaaza lagane, prediction karne, planning batane aur formal announcements mein bhi aata hai — aur B2 se yaad hoga ki jetzt ke saath iska matlab present ka andaaza ho jaata hai.

grammar.title: Futur II: Vermutung über Vergangenes
grammar.hinglish: Futur II do kaam karta hai. Ek, woh kaam batata hai jo kisi future point tak poora ho chuka hoga. Aur do, past ke baare mein andaaza — Die Forscher werden die Daten schon ausgewertet haben matlab “shaayad unhone data analyse kar hi liya hoga”. Academic aur journalistic writing mein yeh doosra use zyada aata hai.

grammar.title: Futur II: die Form
grammar.hinglish: Futur II hi ek aisa tense hai jo tumne pehle nahi banaya, isliye iski shape dekh lo: werden (conjugated, position 2) + Partizip II + haben ya sein, dono sabse end mein. Auxiliary ka faisla wahi hai jo Perfekt mein hota hai — movement aur state change wale verbs sein lete hain, baaki haben. Aur iske do matlab hote hain, jo context se tay hote hain: agar future ka time word ho to matlab hai “tab tak ho chuka hoga”, aur agar wohl, schon ya sicher ho to matlab hai “shaayad ho hi chuka hai” — yani past ke baare mein andaaza.

grammar.title: Narrative Tempuswechsel
grammar.hinglish: Achhe writers tense jaan-boojhkar badalte hain, bina wajah nahi. Pattern aksar yeh hota hai — kahani Präteritum mein, background Plusquamperfekt mein, aur beech mein koi tippani Präsens mein, phir wapas kahani par. Reader ko har badlav se pata chalna chahiye ki ab kaunsi layer chal rahi hai.

grammar.title: Meister-Tempustabelle
grammar.hinglish: Har tense ke do kaam hote hain — ek uska basic matlab, aur ek uska style wala use. C1 par asli farak doosre column se padta hai, isliye is table ko usi nazar se dekho.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: In paanchon mein grammar galat nahi hai — style galat hai. Yahi woh farak hai jo B2 aur C1 ke beech hota hai, aur exam mein yahi dekha jaata hai.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Koi ghatna batani hai? Baatcheet mein Perfekt, novel ya kahani mein Präteritum, research aur academic writing mein Präsens, prediction ke liye Futur I, aur past ke andaaze ke liye Futur II. Pehle context dekho, phir tense chuno.

quiz.q: What is historic present used for?
options: Narrating a past event vividly, as if happening now
quiz.explain: Historic present borrows present tense forms to make past events feel immediate.

quiz.q: Which tense dominates literary/written narration?
quiz.explain: Novels and formal narration consistently use Präteritum.

quiz.q: What does Plusquamperfekt typically express?
quiz.explain: Plusquamperfekt lets writers step further back in time to give background before the main narrative.

quiz.q: What can Futur II express besides a completed future event?
quiz.explain: Futur II (werden + Partizip II + haben/sein) is used for speculation about something that already happened.

quiz.q: B2 asks "which tense is correct?" What does C1 ask?
quiz.explain: Mastering stylistic tense choice is the defining step from B2 to C1 writing.

title: Raum & Zeit präzise ausdrücken
desc: B2 asks "Where?" and "When?" C1 asks "Exactly where, exactly when, in relation to what, and for how long?" Precision defines C1 German.

story.headline: Not just where and when — exactly where and when.
story.intro: Organizing a research trip across Germany, Grit needs Timo's answer immediately after the meeting, and he promises the report within the week — every plan pinned down with precise spatial and temporal expressions, not just "where" and "when".

lines.de: Ich brauche deine Antwort unmittelbar nach der Sitzung.
lines.en: I need your answer immediately after the meeting.
lines.hi: Mujhe baithak ke turant baad tumhaara jawaab chahiye.

lines.de: Gut. Im Laufe der Woche sende ich dir den Bericht.
lines.en: In the course of the week I will send you the report.
lines.hi: Hafte ke dauraan main tumhe report bhejunga.

lines.de: Perfekt! Können wir das gleichzeitig mit der Präsentation bearbeiten?
lines.en: Can we work on that simultaneously with the presentation?
lines.hi: Kya hum use prastuti ke saath ek saath kar sakte hain?

lines.de: Ja. In unmittelbarer Nähe des Termins planen wir das Meeting.
lines.en: Yes. In immediate vicinity of the appointment, we plan the meeting.
lines.hi: Haan. Mulaqaat ke bilkul aas-paas, hum meeting ki yojana banaate hain.

lines.de: Im Rahmen des Projekts sollten wir auch das Budget besprechen.
lines.en: Within the framework of the project we should also discuss the budget.
lines.hi: Pariyojana ke dhaanche ke bheetar, humein budget par bhi charcha karni chahiye.

lines.de: Einverstanden! Dann sehen wir uns morgen.
lines.en: Agreed! Then we see each other tomorrow.
lines.hi: Sahmat! Toh kal milte hain.

grammar.title: Warum Präzision zählt
grammar.hinglish: Farak dekho: Nach dem Essen … aur Unmittelbar nach Abschluss der Besprechung …. Dono sahi hain, par doosra batata hai ki kab exactly. C1 par yahi expect kiya jaata hai — sirf sahi nahi, balki precise.

grammar.title: Präzise Zeitausdrücke
grammar.hinglish: Yeh time expressions nach aur vor se kahin zyada precise hain. Inhe function ke hisaab se yaad karo — turant ke liye unmittelbar nach/vor, saath-saath ke liye gleichzeitig mit aur parallel zu, aur ab tak ke liye seither, bislang, inzwischen.

grammar.title: Chronologische Beziehungen
grammar.hinglish: Ghatnaon ko order mein rakhne ke liye yeh chain kaam aati hai: pehle, isi beech, turant baad, phir baad mein, aur ant mein. Har step ka apna shabd hai, isliye reader ko timeline saaf dikhti hai.

grammar.title: Gleichzeitigkeit (Simultaneity)
grammar.hinglish: Saath-saath hone ke liye kai shabd hain, par register alag hai. gleichzeitig sabse aam hai, zeitgleich zyada formal aur technical lagta hai, währenddessen kahani mein aata hai, aur zugleich aksar do pehlu jodne ke liye.

grammar.title: Dauer (Duration)
grammar.hinglish: Kitne samay tak, yeh batane ke liye: über einen Zeitraum von, im Laufe der Zeit, über mehrere Jahrzehnte hinweg. Dhyaan do ki hinweg hamesha noun ke baad aata hai.

grammar.title: Präzise Raumausdrücke
grammar.hinglish: Jagah batane ke liye yeh expressions in aur bei se kahin precise hain. oberhalb aur unterhalb über/unter se zyada exact hain, aur in unmittelbarer Nähe ya im Umkreis formal writing mein bahut aate hain.

grammar.title: Kasus bei diesen Ausdrücken
grammar.hinglish: Yeh precise expressions tabhi kaam ke hain jab tum inhe sahi case ke saath laga sako — aur asli C1 galtiyan yahin hoti hain, expression chunne mein nahi balki uske baad wali ending mein. Zyada-tar -halb wale (innerhalb, außerhalb, oberhalb, unterhalb) aur während, im Laufe Genitiv lete hain. Par jaise hi von ya zu aata hai, case Dativ ho jaata hai — innerhalb von drei Tagen. Aur entlang ka apna niyam hai: noun ke baad aaye to Akkusativ (den Fluss entlang), aur pehle aaye to Dativ.

grammar.title: Abstrakter Raum (metaphorisch)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh jagah wale shabd abstract matlab mein bhi chalte hain — aur academic writing mein yahi use sabse zyada aata hai. im Mittelpunkt stehen matlab kisi cheez par focus hona, im Rahmen matlab kisi cheez ke andar, aur auf internationaler Ebene matlab international level par.

grammar.title: Zeitausdruckstabelle
grammar.hinglish: Function ke hisaab se grouped — pehle yeh socho ki tum kya batana chahte ho (turant, saath-saath, ya kitni der), phir uske group se expression chuno.

grammar.title: Raumausdruckstabelle
grammar.hinglish: Function ke hisaab se grouped — pehle yeh socho ki tum kya batana chahte ho (turant, saath-saath, ya kitni der), phir uske group se expression chuno.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh galtiyan do wajah se hoti hain — do expressions ko ek saath jod dena jo ek hi kaam karte hain, ya case galat laga dena. Precise banne ke chakkar mein zyada shabd mat jodo; ek sahi expression kaafi hai.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Samay batana hai? Pehle decide karo — turant, saath-saath, ya kitni der. Jagah batani hai? Decide karo — position, direction, ya abstract. Phir us group se sabse precise expression chuno, aur uska case check kar lo.

quiz.q: What does "unmittelbar nach" precisely express?
quiz.explain: "Unmittelbar" adds precision — it means immediately, not just "after" in general.

quiz.q: Which expression marks simultaneity?
quiz.explain: "Gleichzeitig" precisely marks two actions happening at the same time.

quiz.q: What does "im Laufe der Zeit" express?
options: An extended duration during which something develops
quiz.explain: "Im Laufe" expresses a duration or course, often gradual development.

quiz.q: What does "im Rahmen" mean when used abstractly?
quiz.explain: "Im Rahmen" is an abstract spatial metaphor common in academic writing, meaning "within the scope of".

quiz.q: B2 asks "Where?" and "When?" What does C1 ask?
options: "Exactly where/when, in relation to what, and for how long?"
quiz.explain: Precision — exact spatial and temporal relationships — is a defining characteristic of C1 German.

title: Nebensätze sicher beherrschen
desc: C1 is not about knowing more conjunctions — it is about controlling sentence architecture. Build hierarchy, not just length.

story.headline: Not more conjunctions — better sentence architecture.
story.intro: Antje edits a joint university research paper with Timo, flagging his nested subordinate clauses as impressive but unclear — the fix isn't more conjunctions, but rebuilding the sentence's whole architecture.

lines.de: Deine Satzarchitektur ist beeindruckend, aber die Nebensatzhierarchie ist manchmal unklar.

grammar.title: Warum Satzarchitektur zählt
grammar.hinglish: C1 par lambe sentence banana koi lakshya nahi hai — asli baat yeh hai ki kai ideas ko ek saaf structure mein rakh sako. Ek basic sentence lo aur usme dheere-dheere layers jodo, phir dekho ki matlab kaise saaf rehta hai.

grammar.title: Satzhierarchie (Clause Hierarchy)
grammar.hinglish: Lambe sentence ko layers ki tarah socho — main clause sabse upar, uske andar subordinate clause, uske andar aur ek. Padhte waqt sabse pehle main clause ka verb dhoondo; usi se poora dhaancha samajh mein aa jaata hai.

grammar.title: Mehrere Nebensätze (Multiple Subordinate Clauses)
grammar.hinglish: Ek hi sentence mein kai conjunctions aa sakte hain — weil, obwohl, nachdem, bevor, während, sobald, sofern, falls, indem, sodass, ohne dass, anstatt dass. Har ek apna clause banata hai aur har clause ka verb apne end mein jaata hai. Isliye ek sentence mein teen clause hon to teen verbs alag-alag jagah band honge.

grammar.title: Verschachtelte Nebensätze (Nested Clauses)
grammar.hinglish: Nested clause matlab clause ke andar clause. Padhne ka tarika yeh hai — har comma par ruko, dekho kaunsa naya clause khula, aur uska verb dhoondo. Likhte waqt ulta karo: pehle main clause poora karo, phir ek-ek layer jodo. Do se zyada layers likhne mein reader ko mushkil hoti hai, isliye padhne ke liye teen samjho par likhne mein do hi kaafi hain.

grammar.title: Verwechselbare Konjunktionen
grammar.hinglish: Upar wali list mein kuch jodiyan aisi hain jo ek jaisi lagti hain par hain nahi — aur C1 par sahi wala chunna hi asli control dikhata hai. weil naya reason deta hai aur bolchaal mein zyada aata hai, jabki da tab lagta hai jab reason pehle se pata ho, aur woh formal lagta hai. falls ka matlab hai “agar”, par sofern ek shart lagata hai — “sirf tab jab”. sodass result batata hai jo apne aap hua, aur damit woh maksad jo tumne chaha tha. Aur ek baat aasaan hai — in sab mein verb clause ke end mein hi jaata hai, sirf matlab badalta hai.

grammar.title: Parallele Nebensätze (Parallel Clauses)
grammar.hinglish: Do baaton ko barabar weight dena ho to yeh jodiyan kaam aati hain: sowohl … als auch, nicht nur … sondern auch, einerseits … andererseits. Dhyaan do ki dono taraf ek hi tarah ka element aana chahiye — dono noun, ya dono verb.

grammar.title: Satzreduktion (Clause Reduction)
grammar.hinglish: Har baat ke liye poora clause banane ki zaroorat nahi hoti. …, ohne dass er eine Pause machte ko chhota karke …, ohne eine Pause zu machen kiya jaa sakta hai. Isse style saaf aur zyada C1 jaisa lagta hai — par sab kuch reduce mat karo, warna text bhaari ho jaata hai.

grammar.title: Informationsfluss (Information Flow)
grammar.hinglish: Ek sentence ke andar bhi information ka order hota hai — pehle jo pata hai, phir nayi baat, phir uska explanation aur proof, aur ant mein nateeja. Yeh wahi known-to-new flow hai jo B2 mein dekha tha, bas ab ek hi lambe sentence ke andar.

grammar.title: Häufige Satzmuster (Common Clause Patterns)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh table pattern se conjunction dhoondne ke liye hai — pehle socho ki tum kaunsa rishta batana chahte ho (cause, contrast, time, condition, purpose, method), phir uska conjunction chuno.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: C1 par alag-alag clause aksar sahi hote hain — tootta dhaancha hai. Verb kho jaata hai, aage rakhe clause ke baad inversion nahi hoti, ya do structures aapas mein mila diye jaate hain.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Ek hi baat kehni hai? Simple sentence kaafi hai. Do judi hui baatein? Ek subordinate clause. Kai rishte batane hain? Layers banao. Aur C1 style chahiye? Jahan clause ki zaroorat na ho, wahan use chhota kar do. Yaad rakho — lamba sentence apne aap achha nahi hota, saaf structure achha hota hai.

quiz.q: What is the main goal of C1 clause architecture?
options: Organizing multiple ideas into clear hierarchy
quiz.explain: C1 writing is about clear hierarchy and control, not length for its own sake.

quiz.q: What does clause reduction achieve stylistically?
options: Replaces relative clauses with participial attributes for elegance
quiz.explain: "Der Bericht, der veröffentlicht wurde" → "der veröffentlichte Bericht" is a classic C1 reduction.

quiz.q: What does "sowohl...als auch" express?
quiz.explain: Parallel structures balance two ideas of equal weight in one sentence.

quiz.q: What is a common C1 mistake regarding "weil"?
options: Overusing it instead of varying cause expressions
quiz.explain: Repeating "weil" throughout a text sounds monotonous and B1-level; vary with "da", nominalization, or reduction.

quiz.q: B2 asks "Can I build a subordinate clause?" What does C1 ask?
options: "How can I organize four ideas into one elegant sentence?"
quiz.explain: C1 mastery is about sentence planning and hierarchy, not just correctness or brevity.

title: Hauptsätze elegant verbinden
desc: C1 writing is judged by how ideas flow — not by sentence length alone. B2 asks which connector is correct; C1 asks which connector makes the text flow naturally.

story.headline: Elegant German comes from logical progression, not more words.
story.intro: Revising an academic article before submitting it to their professor, Wenke and Timo replace repetitive sentence sequences describing their sustainability initiative with elegantly coordinated main clauses — moreover, beyond that, nevertheless.

grammar.title: Warum Textfluss zählt
grammar.hinglish: Teen chhote alag-alag sentences aur ek jude hue version ko saath rakh kar dekho. Dono mein baat wahi hai, par jude hue version mein reader ko dikhta hai ki ek baat doosri se kaise judi hai — aur C1 par yahi dekha jaata hai.

grammar.title: Fortgeschrittene koordinierende Konnektoren
grammar.hinglish: Yeh connectors und aur aber se kahin zyada precise hain. Jodne ke liye zudem, außerdem, darüber hinaus, ferner; ulti baat ke liye dennoch, allerdings, hingegen, dagegen; aur nateeje ke liye folglich, somit, infolgedessen, daher. Dhyaan do ki ferner aur somit kaafi formal hain — yeh bolchaal mein kam aate hain.

grammar.title: Konnektorposition (Connector Placement)
grammar.hinglish: In connectors ke saath order fix hai: connector position 1 par, verb turant uske baad, aur subject phir. Isliye Außerdem wurde … aur Dennoch bleibt …. Ek galti se bacho — inke baad comma nahi lagta.

grammar.title: Drei Konnektortypen — drei Wortstellungen
grammar.hinglish: Yeh rule — connector position 1 par aur verb position 2 par — sirf is chapter wale adverbs par lagta hai, har connector par nahi. Teen type hote hain aur teeno ka word order alag hai. Konjunktionaladverb (zudem, dennoch, folglich) position 1 le leta hai, isliye verb turant baad aata hai. Koordinierende Konjunktion (und, aber, denn, sondern, oder) koi position leti hi nahi — uske baad normal order chalta hai, isliye …, denn die Nachfrage ist gestiegen. Aur subordinierende Konjunktion (weil, obwohl, da) verb ko clause ke end mein bhej deti hai. Kuch adverbs flexible hain — jedoch, allerdings, hingegen beech mein bhi baith sakte hain.

grammar.title: Logische Beziehungen
grammar.hinglish: Connector English translation dekh kar mat chuno — pehle yeh socho ki dono baaton ka rishta kya hai. Kya doosri baat pehli ka nateeja hai, uske ulat hai, ya usme kuch aur jod rahi hai? Rishta tay ho jaaye to connector apne aap mil jaata hai.

grammar.title: Koordination vs Subordination
grammar.hinglish: Dono style kab use hote hain, yeh dekho. Coordination do barabar baaton ko jodta hai aur zyada dynamic lagta hai, isliye journalism mein aata hai. Subordination ek baat ko doosri par tikata hai aur zyada analytical lagta hai, isliye academic writing mein.

grammar.title: Satzrhythmus (Sentence Rhythm)
grammar.hinglish: Sirf chhote sentences likho to text tuta-tuta lagta hai, aur sirf lambe likho to bhaari. Behtar yeh hai ki dono mila kar likho — ek lamba sentence ke baad ek chhota, isse reader ko saans milti hai aur baat saaf rehti hai.

grammar.title: Konnektorfunktionen (Connector Functions)
grammar.hinglish: Function ke hisaab se grouped table — ek hi function ke andar connectors badal-badal kar use karo, taaki ek hi shabd baar-baar na aaye.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Inme se chaar galtiyan ek hi jad se aati hain — yeh bhool jaana ki yeh connectors adverb hain. Isliye woh position 1 le lete hain aur verb ko subject se pehle le aate hain.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Do barabar baatein jodni hain? Coordination use karo. Ek baat doosri par tiki hai? Subordinate clause. Aur C1 style chahiye? Connector badal-badal kar use karo aur sentence ki lambaai mein variety rakho. Sabse pehle yeh check karo ki connector adverb hai ya conjunction — usi se word order tay hoga.

quiz.q: What word order follows a Position-1 connector like "außerdem"?
quiz.explain: German main clauses always keep the finite verb in Position 2, right after whatever occupies Position 1.

quiz.q: Which connector expresses contrast?
quiz.explain: "Dennoch" (nevertheless) expresses a concessive contrast.

quiz.q: Why should you vary connectors like "zudem" and "darüber hinaus"?
options: To avoid monotonous repetition and create elegant text flow
Because only one connector may be used per text
quiz.explain: Repeating the same connector throughout a text weakens C1-level stylistic elegance.

quiz.q: When is coordination generally preferred over subordination?
options: When connecting two equal ideas dynamically, as in journalism
When one idea depends entirely on another
quiz.explain: Coordination suits equal, dynamic ideas; subordination suits analytical dependency, common in academic writing.

quiz.q: B2 asks "Which connector is correct?" What does C1 ask?
options: "Which connector makes the text flow naturally?"
quiz.explain: C1 writing is judged by how ideas flow, not just by grammatical correctness.

title: Zweiteilige Satzverbindungen
desc: Think of paired connectors as bridges. The first word opens the bridge; the second word completes it. Never use only one half.

story.headline: Paired connectors are bridges: never leave one side unconnected.
story.intro: Discussing a job candidate before a conference presentation, Silke argues she convinces both professionally and personally, while Timo notes neither her experience nor her language skills quite suffice — every judgment built on a paired connector, never left half-finished.

lines.de: Die Kandidatin überzeugt sowohl fachlich als auch menschlich.

lines.hi: Ummeedwaar dono pesheva roop se aur maanviya roop se mana leti hai.

lines.de: Je schneller sie lernt, desto eher wird sie produktiv.
lines.en: The faster she learns, the sooner she will be productive.
lines.hi: Jitni jaldi woh seekhegi, utni hi jaldi woh utpaadak hogi.

grammar.title: Was sind Zweiteilige Satzverbindungen?
grammar.hinglish: Single connector ek rishta batata hai. Paired connector do ideas ko barabar weight ke saath jodta hai — aur exam mein yeh turant dikhta hai ki tumhara German C1 level ka hai. Inhe jodi ki tarah socho: pehla shabd pul kholta hai, doosra use poora karta hai.

grammar.title: Addition (sowohl...als auch / nicht nur...sondern auch)
grammar.hinglish: Jodne ke liye do main jodiyan hain. sowohl … als auch dono cheezon ko barabar rakhta hai, aur nicht nur … sondern auch mein zor doosri cheez par padta hai — isliye jo baat highlight karni ho use doosri jagah rakho. ebenso … wie comparison ke liye hai, aur sowohl hinsichtlich … als auch bezüglich kaafi formal hai, sirf academic writing ke liye.

grammar.title: Alternativen (entweder...oder / weder...noch)
grammar.hinglish: entweder … oder do mein se ek chunne ke liye hai, aur weder … noch dono ko mana karne ke liye — isliye uske saath alag se nicht nahi lagta. beziehungsweise (bzw.) formal writing mein aata hai, matlab “ya phir”, aur ob … oder tab jab dono soorat mein baat ek hi rahe.

grammar.title: Kontrast (zwar...aber / einerseits...andererseits)
grammar.hinglish: Contrast ke liye chaar jodiyan hain, par kaam alag hai. zwar … aber mein tum pehle ek baat maan lete ho aur phir usse aage badhte ho. einerseits … andererseits do pehlu barabar rakhta hai. nicht … sondern pehli baat ko kaat kar sahi baat batata hai — aur yahi ek hai jisme sondern aata hai, kyunki uske pehle negation hai.

grammar.title: Vergleich (je...desto / genauso...wie)
grammar.hinglish: je … desto aur je … umso ka matlab ek hi hai — jitna zyada ek, utna zyada doosra. Dono chalte hain, bas desto zyada common hai. genauso … wie barabari batata hai, aur mehr … als farak. Yaad rakho ki barabari mein wie aata hai aur farak mein als.

grammar.title: Wortstellung und Kongruenz
grammar.hinglish: Zyada-tar paired connectors word order nahi badalte — par teen baatein sentence ko sahi ya galat bana deti hain. Sabse pehle je … desto: je wala hissa subordinate clause hai, isliye uska verb end mein jaata hai, aur phir desto + comparative + verb + subject aata hai. Yahi sabse zyada galat hota hai. Doosra, zwar position 1 leta hai, isliye uske turant baad verb aata hai. Teesra, weder … noch khud hi negative hai — uske saath nicht ya kein nahi lagta. Aur verb agreement dekho: sowohl … als auch ke saath plural verb aata hai, par nicht nur … sondern auch mein verb doosre element se match karta hai. Ek aakhri baat — dono taraf ek hi tarah ka element aana chahiye, dono noun ya dono clause.

grammar.title: Ursache und Folge (so...dass / derart...dass)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh jodiyan batati hain ki koi cheez itni zyada thi ki uska ek nateeja nikla. so … dass sabse aam hai, aur derart … dass ya in einem solchen Maß … dass zyada formal. Dhyaan do ki dass wale hisse ka verb end mein jaata hai.

grammar.title: Einschränkung und Ausnahme (weder...noch / nicht etwa...sondern)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh jodiyan baat ko seemit karti hain. nicht etwa … sondern ek galat andaaze ko hataa kar sahi baat rakhta hai, aur erst … dann order batata hai — pehle yeh, uske baad woh.

grammar.title: Master-Tabelle
grammar.hinglish: Function ke hisaab se table — pehle socho ki tumhe kya karna hai (jodna, chunna, contrast, comparison, degree), phir usi row se jodi uthao. Ek hi jodi baar-baar mat use karo.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Inme se zyada-tar galtiyan tooti hui jodi ki hain — doosra hissa galat, ya hai hi nahi. Aakhri wali mein word order bhi galat hai, aur je … desto mein yahi sabse zyada log galat karte hain.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Do barabar baatein jodni hain? sowohl … als auch. Chunna hai? entweder … oder. Dono mana karne hain? weder … noch. Contrast? zwar … aber. Ek badhe to doosra badhe? je … desto. Aur nateeja batana hai? so … dass. Jodi shuru kar di hai to use poora karna mat bhoolo.

quiz.q: What is the required second half of "sowohl"?
quiz.explain: "Sowohl" must always be completed with "als auch" to form a complete correlative bridge.

quiz.q: What does "entweder...oder" express?
options: A choice between exactly two options
quiz.explain: "Entweder...oder" presents exactly two mutually exclusive options.

quiz.q: What is the required second half of "weder"?
quiz.explain: "Weder" must always be completed with "noch", never "oder".

quiz.q: What does "je...desto" require in both clauses?
options: A comparative adjective/adverb in each clause
A question word in each clause
quiz.explain: "Je + Komparativ, desto + Komparativ" requires a comparative form on both sides of the bridge.

quiz.q: What is the memory trick for paired connectors?
options: They are bridges — never use only one half
They can always be replaced with "und"
Only the first half matters grammatically
quiz.explain: A bridge is complete only when both sides are connected — the first word opens it, the second completes it.

grammar.title: Revisionskarte (Revision Map)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh checkpoint Chapter 1 se 5 tak ka sab kuch ek saath test karta hai, alag-alag nahi. Asli exam mein bhi yahi hota hai — ek hi text mein tense choice, precise expressions, clause structure aur connectors sab mile-jule aate hain.

grammar.title: Kapitel 1 — Tempusgebrauch (Rückblick)
grammar.hinglish: Tense ka style wala choice: historic present, register ke hisaab se Präteritum ya Perfekt, background ke liye Plusquamperfekt, prediction ke liye Futur I, aur past ke andaaze ke liye Futur II.

grammar.title: Kapitel 2 — Raum & Zeit (Rückblick)
grammar.hinglish: Precise temporal expressions (unmittelbar nach, im Laufe von, seither) aur precise spatial expressions (in unmittelbarer Nähe, gegenüber, im Rahmen).

grammar.title: Kapitel 3 — Nebensätze (Rückblick)
grammar.hinglish: Clause hierarchy, nested clauses, parallel structures, aur clause reduction — matlab poore clause ko chhota karke infinitive banana (ohne dass … se ohne … zu). Saath mein woh confusable jodiyan bhi dekh lo: weil/da, falls/sofern, sodass/damit.

grammar.title: Kapitel 4 — Hauptsatzverbindungen (Rückblick)
grammar.hinglish: Addition (zudem, darüber hinaus), contrast (dennoch, allerdings), result (folglich, somit), parallel (gleichzeitig). Sabse zaroori baat yaad rakho — yeh adverb hain, isliye position 1 lete hain aur verb subject se pehle aa jaata hai. Jabki und, aber, denn koi position lete hi nahi.

grammar.title: Kapitel 5 — Zweiteilige Satzverbindungen (Rückblick)
grammar.hinglish: Correlative pairs pul ki tarah hain: sowohl…als auch, entweder…oder, weder…noch, zwar…aber, je…desto. Jodi shuru ki hai to use poora karo. Aur je … desto ka word order dhyaan mein rakho — je wale hisse ka verb end mein, phir desto + comparative + verb.

grammar.title: Bereitschaftsskala (Readiness Scale)
grammar.hinglish: Apne score ko imaandaari se dekho — yeh scale hi batata hai ki aage badhna hai ya kisi chapter par wapas jaana hai. Kam score koi problem nahi, par use ignore karna problem hai.

grammar.title: Warum Genitivpräpositionen zählen
grammar.hinglish: Yeh prepositions bolchaal mein kam aate hain aur likhi hui German mein bahut. Isliye inhe sabse pehle pehchaanne ke liye seekho — reading mein yeh har jagah milenge — aur phir writing mein use karo, kyunki wahin se formal tone banta hai.

grammar.title: Kern-Genitivpräpositionen
grammar.hinglish: Bees prepositions hain, par sab ek jaise zaroori nahi. Rozmarra ki formal writing mein trotz, während, wegen, aufgrund, innerhalb, außerhalb hi sabse zyada kaam aate hain — inhe likhne ke liye pakka karo. kraft aur ungeachtet legal texts mein aate hain, aur unhe sirf samajhna kaafi hai.

grammar.title: Die Genitivformen selbst
grammar.hinglish: Sahi preposition chun lena aadha kaam hai — uske baad wala noun phrase bhi sahi banana padta hai, aur asli marks yahin katte hain. Masculine aur neuter mein des aata hai aur noun par -s ya -es lagta hai. Feminine aur plural mein der aata hai aur noun waisa hi rehta hai. Ek kaam ki baat — jab article hai hi nahi (khaali plural ya koi number), tab German von + Dativ par chala jaata hai: aufgrund von Problemen, innerhalb von drei Tagen. Isliye von hamesha galat nahi hota; galat tab hai jab uske saath Genitiv article bhi laga do.

grammar.title: Formell vs Gesprochen
grammar.hinglish: Teeno ko saath dekho: wegen des Unwetters formal hai, wegen dem Unwetter bolchaal mein bilkul normal hai (galat nahi, bas casual), aur aufgrund des Unwetters sabse formal. Exam ki writing mein Genitiv wala form hi likho.

grammar.title: Stilistische Alternativen
grammar.hinglish: Yeh sirf formality ki seedhi nahi hai — matlab bhi badalta hai. wegen aam wajah batata hai, aufgrund kisi thos aadhaar par (data, report), infolge ek nateeja jo kisi cheez ke baad aaya, angesichts kisi haalat ko dekhte hue, aur hinsichtlich wajah nahi balki vishay batata hai — isliye woh is list mein thoda alag hai.

grammar.title: Häufige Kollokationen
grammar.hinglish: Yeh asli combinations hain jo texts mein baar-baar aate hain — inhe poore chunk ki tarah yaad karo, kyunki phir article aur ending apne aap sahi aa jaayenge. Dhyaan do ki kraft Gesetzes mein article hai hi nahi; kuch fixed legal phrases aise hi chalte hain.

grammar.title: Meister-Tabelle
grammar.hinglish: Preposition, matlab aur register ka table — likhne se pehle yeh dekh lo ki tumhara text kis register ka hai, phir usi hisaab se preposition chuno.

grammar.title: Registerskala
grammar.hinglish: Jitna formal text hoga, utne zyada Genitiv prepositions milenge. Baatcheet mein yeh kam aate hain, business aur academic writing mein bahut, aur legal texts mein sabse zyada.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Chhe mein se saari galtiyan do wajah se hoti hain — ya to bolchaal wala Dativ formal writing mein aa jaata hai, ya ek extra von lag jaata hai jo case ko do baar mark kar deta hai.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Formal expression chahiye? Wajah ke liye wegen/aufgrund/infolge, vishay ke liye hinsichtlich, tarike ke liye mittels, mauke ke liye anlässlich, aur faayde ke liye zugunsten. Preposition chunne ke baad ek baar noun phrase check karo — article sahi hai aur masculine/neuter par -s laga hai?

quiz.q: What case do Genitive prepositions like "trotz" and "während" require?
quiz.explain: These prepositions formally govern the Genitive case.

quiz.q: Which is the more formal alternative to "wegen"?
quiz.explain: "Aufgrund" is a more formal/academic alternative to "wegen" for expressing cause.

quiz.q: What does "hinsichtlich" introduce?
quiz.explain: "Hinsichtlich + Genitiv" is common in academic writing to introduce a topic.

quiz.q: Is "mittels von" correct?
quiz.explain: "Mittels" already governs the Genitive directly; adding "von" is a common learner mistake.

quiz.q: What is the C1 memory trick for Genitive prepositions?
options: Formal German is recognized instantly through correct Genitive prepositions
They should be avoided in writing
They only appear in spoken German
quiz.explain: Correct Genitive prepositions are one of the strongest signals of advanced written German.

grammar.title: Warum anspruchsvolle Präpositionen zählen
grammar.hinglish: C1 par simple prepositions ki jagah zyada precise wale aa jaate hain — jaise über ki jagah hinsichtlich, bezüglich ya in Bezug auf. Par dhyaan rakho: yeh sirf formal writing ke liye hain. Baatcheet mein inhe use karo to bahut bhaari lagta hai.

grammar.title: Thema & Bezug (Topic & Reference)
grammar.hinglish: Kisi vishay ki baat karne ke liye yeh sab chalte hain. bezüglich business emails mein sabse zyada aata hai, hinsichtlich academic writing mein, aur im Hinblick auf tab jab kisi aage ki cheez ko dhyaan mein rakh kar baat ho. was … betrifft thoda halka aur bolne layak hai. Dhyaan do ki inke case alag-alag hain.

grammar.title: Grund & Ursache (Cause & Reason)
grammar.hinglish: Wajah batane wale sab ek jaise nahi hain. aufgrund kisi thos aadhaar par, infolge ek nateeja jo baad mein aaya, angesichts kisi haalat ko dekhte hue, dank sirf achhi wajah ke liye (aur woh Dativ leta hai), mangels kisi cheez ki kami ke liye, aur zufolge jab baat kisi source se aayi ho — aur woh noun ke baad aata hai.

grammar.title: Zweck & Nutzen (Purpose & Benefit)
grammar.hinglish: Maksad ya faayda batane ke liye: zugunsten (kiske faayde mein), im Interesse (kiske hit mein), zum Zwecke aur im Dienste — yeh dono kaafi formal hain aur zyada-tar official documents mein aate hain.

grammar.title: Methode & Mittel (Method & Means)
grammar.hinglish: Tareeka ya zariya batane ke liye yeh academic expressions hain. anhand tab jab kisi cheez ke aadhaar par kuch dikhaya jaa raha ho (anhand eines Beispiels), mittels aur unter Verwendung jab koi tool ya method use hua ho, aur mithilfe thoda kam formal hai.

grammar.title: Einschränkung & Umfang (Limitation & Scope)
grammar.hinglish: Yeh batate hain ki baat kis daayre ki hai. im Rahmen matlab kisi project ya kaam ke andar, im Bereich kisi field mein, im Zusammenhang mit kisi cheez se jude hue, aur im Vergleich zu tulna ke liye. Aakhri do Dativ lete hain.

grammar.title: Welcher Kasus — nicht alle nehmen Genitiv
grammar.hinglish: Aisa lagta hai ki yeh saare advanced prepositions Genitiv lete hain, par kai nahi lete — aur yahi galti formal writing mein sabse zyada dikhti hai. Jo in … auf ya im … se bane hain, woh apne andar wale chhote preposition ka case rakhte hain. Isliye in Bezug auf die Kosten mein Akkusativ hai, aur im Vergleich zu dem Vorjahr mein Dativ. Do exceptions alag se yaad rakho — dank rozmarra mein Dativ leta hai, aur zufolge apne noun ke baad aata hai. Ek aasaan test: agar expression ke ant mein koi chhota preposition hai (auf, mit, zu), to case wahi tay karega, Genitiv nahi.

grammar.title: Registerunterschiede
grammar.hinglish: Yeh ek register scale hai — über rozmarra ka hai, bezüglich business writing ka, hinsichtlich academic, aur im Hinblick auf sabse formal. Poore text mein ek hi level par raho; ek email mein über aur im Hinblick auf dono mat mila do.

grammar.title: Meister-Tabelle
grammar.hinglish: Matlab se expression dhoondne ke liye table — pehle socho ki tumhe kya batana hai (vishay, wajah, tareeka, maksad, daayra), phir usi row se chuno aur uska case check kar lo.

grammar.title: Typische Fehler (common learner mistakes)
grammar.hinglish: Inme se zyada-tar galtiyan ek hi tarah ki hain — expression mein jo preposition pehle se hai, use dobara laga dena. Aur do exceptions yaad rakho: dank aksar Dativ leta hai, aur in Bezug auf Akkusativ.

grammar.title: Goethe-Prüfungstipps & Entscheidungshilfe
grammar.hinglish: Vishay ki baat? hinsichtlich/bezüglich/in Bezug auf. Wajah? aufgrund/infolge/angesichts. Tareeka? mittels/anhand/mithilfe. Daayra? im Rahmen/im Bereich. Maksad? zugunsten/im Interesse. Expression chunne ke baad hamesha ek baar case check karo — sab Genitiv nahi lete.

quiz.q: Which is the more formal, precise C1 alternative to "über"?
quiz.explain: "Hinsichtlich" is a precise, formal alternative to the basic "über" when referring to a topic.

quiz.q: What does "dank" express that "wegen" does not?
quiz.explain: "Dank" implies a positive cause, unlike the neutral "wegen".

quiz.q: Is "bezüglich von" correct?
quiz.explain: "Bezüglich" already governs the Genitive directly; "von" is unnecessary.

quiz.q: What does "im Rahmen" express?
options: Scope/limitation of a project or discussion
quiz.explain: "Im Rahmen" precisely bounds the scope of something, like a project or study.

quiz.q: What is the C1 memory trick for preposition choice?
options: C1 asks which preposition is the most precise, formal and natural
C1 asks only if it is grammatically correct
quiz.explain: At C1, preposition choice is a stylistic decision — precision and register matter as much as correctness.
